desc: You’ll catch every detail with Athlon’s latest spotting scope. Featuring a smooth single focus wheel, finely geared to facilitate hitting the sharpest focus. The Cronus G2 offers greater color definition, clarity, and light transmission than its brethren. From scouting game on a shadowed treeline to identifying birds in dimly wooded forests, the Cronus G2’s enhanced contrast helps separate your subject from its background.
